faqs.q: Sec. 86-41. - City pick up of members' contributions.
faqs.a:
Effective May 1, 1989, a member's contribution will be picked up and paid by the city
               as provided in section 414(h) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, and
               a member's gross income will be reduced by the amount of the contributions picked
               up by the city. Each member as a condition of his employment, is deemed to have authorized
               the city to reduce the member's compensation by such amount from each of his paychecks
               and to transmit such amount directly to the custodian of the pension fund. Records
               will be maintained so as to identify the amounts contributed by each member prior
               to the pickup of such contributions by the city and the contributions picked up by
               the city. For the purposes of distributions from the police pension fund, the amounts
               picked up and paid by the city are considered as city contributions.
(Code 1981, § 26-10.5; Ord. No. 2610, § 2, 4-17-1989)
